## Prop. heads attending to disambiguating word

```{r}
df_attn_by_head = df_all_models %>%
  group_by(model_name, language, multilingual, Layer, Head, n_params) %>%
  summarise(mean_attention = mean(Attention),
            mean_prev_attention = mean(prev_token_attention),
            mean_next_attention = mean(next_token_attention),
            mean_diff_prev = mean(disambiguating_prev_diff),
            mean_diff_next = mean(disambiguating_next_diff)) %>%
  group_by(model_name, language, n_params) %>%
  mutate(z_attention = scale(mean_attention),
         z_prev_attention = scale(mean_prev_attention),
         z_next_attention = scale(mean_next_attention),
         z_diff_prev = scale(mean_diff_prev),
         z_diff_next = scale(mean_diff_next))

df_attn_by_head %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = z_attention)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = .6, bins = 15) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(x = "Mean Attention (z-scored)") +
   theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~model_name + language) 

df_attn_by_head %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_attention)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = .6, bins = 15) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .2, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(x = "Mean Attention (raw)") +
   theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~model_name + language) 




```

## Modeling attention capacity

```{r}
thresholds <- seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05)

# Compute for each threshold
sensitivity_df <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(thresh) {
  df_attn_by_head %>%
    mutate(disambiguating = mean_attention > thresh) %>%
    group_by(model_name, multilingual, language, n_params) %>%
    summarise(
      threshold = thresh,
      count_disambiguating = sum(disambiguating),
      total_heads = n(),
      prop_disambiguating = mean(disambiguating),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
})

ggplot(sensitivity_df, aes(x = threshold, y = prop_disambiguating,
                           color = multilingual)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~language) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of Disambiguation-Capable Heads",
       x = "Attention Threshold",
       y = "Proportion of Heads > Threshold",
       color = "Multilingual") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Yes" = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)[1],
               "No"  = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)[2])
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# Grouped AUC calculation using trapezoid rule
sensitivity_df_sorted <- sensitivity_df %>%
  arrange(model_name, language, multilingual, threshold)

auc_df <- sensitivity_df_sorted %>%
  group_by(model_name, language, multilingual, n_params) %>%
  summarise(
    auc = sum(diff(threshold) * head(count_disambiguating, -1) +
              diff(threshold) * tail(count_disambiguating, -1)) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

auc_summary <- auc_df %>%
  group_by(multilingual, language) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_auc = mean(auc),
    se_auc = sd(auc) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(auc_summary, aes(x = language, y = mean_auc, fill = multilingual)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_auc - se_auc, ymax = mean_auc + se_auc),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Attention Capacity for Disambiguation",
    x = "",
    y = "AUC (Mean ± SE)",
    fill = "Multilingual"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Yes" = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)[1],
               "No"  = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)[2])
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

summary(lm(data = auc_df,
           auc ~ multilingual + language))

```


## More on attention capacity

```{r}
df_layerwise_attn <- df_attn_by_head %>%
  group_by(model_name, Layer, language, multilingual, n_params) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_attention = mean(mean_attention),
    max_attention = max(mean_attention),
    se_attention = sd(mean_attention) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summarize multilingual vs. not
summary_df <- df_layerwise_attn %>%
  group_by(multilingual, Layer, language) %>%
  summarise(avg_attention = mean(avg_attention),
            avg_max_attn = mean(max_attention))



df_layerwise_attn %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Layer, y = avg_attention, color = model_name)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(10, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +

            aes(x = Layer, 
                y = avg_attention,

df_layerwise_attn = df_layerwise_attn %>%

df_layerwise_attn %>%

df_layerwise_attn %>%

### Isotropy by layer depth ratio
df_layerwise_attn = df_layerwise_attn %>% 
  mutate(prop_layer_scaled = scale(prop_layer))


mod_full = lmer(data = df_layerwise_attn,
                avg_attention ~ prop_layer_scaled + 
                  multilingual * language +
                  language + 
                  log10(n_params) +
                  (1|model_name),
                REML = FALSE)
summary(mod_full)

mod_full = lmer(data = df_layerwise_attn,
                max_attention ~ prop_layer_scaled + 
                  multilingual * language +
                  language + 
                  log10(n_params) +
                  (1|model_name),
                REML = FALSE)
summary(mod_full)
```

## Does attention capacity predict R2?

```{r}
### Load data and calculate $R^2$
directory_path <- "../data/processed/distances/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))
df_distances <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(
    model_name = sub(".*/", "", mpath)
  ) %>%
  mutate(language = str_to_title(language))


df_original_models_r2 = df_distances %>%
  group_by(model_name, multilingual, language, n_params, Layer) %>%
  summarise(r = cor(Distance, mean_relatedness)) %>%
  mutate(r2 = r ** 2) %>%
  group_by(model_name, n_params, multilingual, language) %>%
  summarise(max_r2 = max(r2))  %>%
  mutate(log_params = log10(n_params))



### Testing
THRESHOLD = 0.4
df_capacity = df_attn_by_head %>%
  mutate(is_disambiguating = mean_attention > THRESHOLD) %>%
  group_by(model_name, n_params, language, multilingual) %>%
  summarise(
    count_disambiguating = sum(is_disambiguating),
    max_attn = max(mean_attention),
    total_heads = n(),
    prop_disambiguating = mean(is_disambiguating)
  )

df_capacity %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = max_attn,
             fill = multilingual,
             y = language)) +
  geom_density_ridges2(aes(height = ..density..), 
                       color=NA, 
                       scale=.85, 
                       # size=1, 
                       alpha = .8,
                       stat="density") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Yes" = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)[1],
               "No"  = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)[2])
  ) +
  labs(fill = "Multilingual",
       x = "Max Attn. to Disambiguating Word",
       y = "") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") 

### Join
df_r2_plus_attention_capacity = df_original_models_r2 %>%
  inner_join(df_capacity)




#### Establish that max_attn is correlated
summary(lm(data = df_r2_plus_attention_capacity,
           max_r2 ~
             log_params + 
             language + 
             max_attn))


### Now do mediation analysis
mod_A <- lm(max_r2 ~ multilingual + 
                language + log10(n_params),
              data = df_r2_plus_attention_capacity)

mod_B <- lm(max_attn ~ multilingual, 
              data = df_r2_plus_attention_capacity)

mod_C <- lm(max_r2 ~ multilingual + max_attn + 
                  language + 
                  log10(n_params),
              data = df_r2_plus_attention_capacity)

coef_A <- coef(mod_A)["multilingualYes"]
coef_C <- coef(mod_C)["multilingualYes"]

# Proportion of multilingual effect explained by adding mean #tokens
prop_explained <- (coef_A - coef_C) / coef_A
prop_explained

```



## Multilingual models

### Cross-linguistic comparison

```{r attn_across_langues}
df_attn_by_head = df_all_models %>%
  filter(multilingual == "Yes") %>%
  group_by(model_name, language, Layer, Head, n_params) %>%
  summarise(mean_attention = mean(Attention)) %>%
  group_by(model_name, language) %>%
  mutate(z_attention = scale(mean_attention))

df_diff <- df_attn_by_head %>%
  select(model_name, language, Layer, Head, z_attention) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = language, 
              values_from = z_attention) %>%
  mutate(attn_diff = Spanish - English,
         min_attn = pmin(English, Spanish),
         mean_attn = (English+Spanish)/2)

df_diff %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Layer,
             y = Head,
             fill = attn_diff)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Head",
       fill = "Attention Difference (Spanish - English)") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Attention Difference (Spanish - English)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~model_name)

df_diff %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Layer,
             y = Head,
             fill = min_attn)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Head",
       fill = "Min. Attn. Across Languages") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Min. Attn. Across Languages") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +

df_diff %>%

       y = "Head",

# Now fit the regression model for each head
model_results <- df_all_models %>%
  filter(multilingual == "Yes") %>%
  group_by(model_name, Layer, Head) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    tidy_model = map(data, ~ lm(
      Attention ~ prev_token_attention + next_token_attention + language + cue_pos,
      data = .x
    ) %>% tidy())
  ) %>%
  select(-data) %>%  # drop the full token-level data
  unnest(tidy_model) 

table(model_results$term)

### Coefficient for Spanish-specific attention,

### Do PCA over attentional features for raw data
### TODO: Add in 
df_mean_attn = df_all_models %>%
  filter(multilingual == "Yes") %>%
  group_by(model_name, language, Layer, Head, n_params) %>%
  summarise(mean_attention = mean(Attention)) %>%
  select(model_name, language, Layer, Head, mean_attention) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = language, 
              values_from = mean_attention) %>%
  mutate(English_disamb = English,
         Spanish_disamb = Spanish) %>%
  select(Layer, Head, model_name,
         English_disamb, Spanish_disamb)

df_prev_attn = df_all_models %>%
  filter(multilingual == "Yes") %>%
  group_by(model_name, language, Layer, Head, n_params) %>%
  summarise(mean_prev_attention = mean(prev_token_attention)) %>%
  select(model_name, language, Layer, Head, mean_prev_attention) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = language, 
              values_from = mean_prev_attention) %>%
  mutate(English_prev = English,
         Spanish_prev = Spanish) %>%
  select(Layer, Head, model_name,
         English_prev, Spanish_prev)

df_next_attn = df_all_models %>%
  filter(multilingual == "Yes") %>%
  group_by(model_name, language, Layer, Head, n_params) %>%
  summarise(mean_next_attention = mean(next_token_attention)) %>%
  select(model_name, language, Layer, Head, mean_next_attention) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = language, 
              values_from = mean_next_attention) %>%
  mutate(English_next = English,
         Spanish_next = Spanish)%>%
  select(Layer, Head, model_name,
         English_next, Spanish_next)


df_attns = df_next_attn %>%
  inner_join(df_prev_attn) %>%
  inner_join(df_mean_attn)

pca_features <- df_attns %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-Layer, -Head, -model_name) %>%
  # select(-model_name) %>%
  scale()  # Standardize

pca_result <- prcomp(pca_features, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(pca_result)  # Check variance explained

explained_var_ratio <- explained_var / sum(explained_var)

  Variance_Explained = explained_var_ratio
)
```
